headline: Executive order closed federal government departments and agencies on January 2, 2007.
what_it_does: This order closed executive branch departments and agencies of the federal government for one day, January 2, 2007. Only the title is available, so details such as exceptions for certain offices or workers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Most did not have to report to work on January 2, 2007, because their departments and agencies were closed.

who_it_affects.group: People who needed in-person federal services
who_it_affects.how: They could not get services from closed federal offices on that day.
